Example 7. Solve the following equations :
$$5x - 3y = 9$$
$$3x - 5y = -1$$

Solution : The given equations are
$$5x - 3y = 9 \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots (1)$$
$$3x - 5y = -1 \dots \dots \dots \dots \dots (2)$$

Multiplying equation (1) by 5 and equation (2) by 3 we get
